# Lorenzo Germini

> AI Product Engineer shipping production systems end-to-end across compliance, health, and education. Based in Turin, Italy.

## Profile

I'm an AI product engineer: I take LLM systems from idea to production and stay responsible for the whole path — the infrastructure, the product decisions, and whether the thing actually helps anyone.

Right now that means building the AI engine behind Complaion, a compliance platform for European SMEs getting and keeping ISO certifications: multi-provider LLM infrastructure, agentic RAG, and the evals that keep both honest. Before that: AI for pharma manufacturing at GSK, AI R&D in digital health, and a GenAI EdTech startup I built as founding engineer. The through-line: technical depth only matters when it connects to a real user problem.

Outside work: sports, GenAI side projects, and rabbit holes on tech entrepreneurship and biohacking.

## Skills

Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Full-Stack Development, Python

## Experience

- AI Engineer at Complaion (May 2025 - Present): Building the AI engine behind a compliance automation platform for European SMEs. Multi-provider LLM infrastructure (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini), agentic RAG over ISO documentation, and evaluation frameworks that keep both honest in production.
- Founding AI Engineer at Stealth GenAI Startup (Nov 2024 - Apr 2025)
- AI Engineer at GSK (Sep 2023 - Oct 2024)
- Teacher and Digital Freelancer (Nov 2022 - Aug 2023)
- Engineering Intern at Burgeon Labs (Feb 2022 - Oct 2022)
- Summer Intern at Roche - Think Tank in Innovation & Sustainability (Jul 2021 - Oct 2021)

## Education

- MSc in Life Sciences Engineering (Neuroscience & Neuroengineering), Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Lausanne (EPFL) (2020-2022)
- Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Polytechnic of Turin (2017-2020)

## Projects

- L'Oracolo della Ghigliottina: AI game companion for the final round of Italy's most-watched quiz show — 100% accuracy so far, with rate-limit handling
- Biomedical Paper Summarizer: MSc thesis work — an end-to-end pipeline turning full-text biomedical papers into a detailed analysis or a TL;DR
